CustomField.description: Indicates the product type by which order gets created
CustomField.formula: IF(SBQQ__RequiredBy__c !=null, IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__RequiredBy__r.NSP_Product_Type__c, 'iSolved Hardware'), SBQQ__Quote__r.NSP_Has_WX_product__c = true ),'IWX Bundle', IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__RequiredBy__r.NSP_Product_Type__c, 'iSolved Hardware'), SBQQ__Quote__r.NSP_Has_WA_product__c = true),'IWA Bundle', IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__RequiredBy__r.NSP_Product_Type__c, 'iSolved Hardware'), SBQQ__Quote__r.NSP_Has_IPS__c = true),'IPS Conversion', TEXT(SBQQ__RequiredBy__r.NSP_Product_Type__c)))),IF(AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(NSP_Product_Type__c, 'iSolved Hardware'),SBQQ__ProductCode__c ='ITSTimeSimplicitySU'),SBQQ__Quote__r.NSP_Has_WX_product__c = true), 'IWX Bundle', IF(AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(NSP_Product_Type__c, 'iSolved Hardware'),SBQQ__ProductCode__c ='ITSTimeSimplicitySU'), SBQQ__Quote__r.NSP_Has_WA_product__c = true),'IWA Bundle', IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(NSP_Product_Type__c, 'iSolved Hardware'), SBQQ__Quote__r.NSP_Has_IPS__c = true),'IPS Conversion', IF(AND(SBQQ__ProductCode__c ='IPSSU',SBQQ__Quote__r.NSP_Has_LASSO_product__c = true),'Lasso', TEXT(NSP_Product_Type__c))))))
CustomField.label: Order Product Type
